dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, closed 'O' and open 'C' shapes exhibit crenulated or serrated outer perimeters with sharp gradient transitions from a dark brownish-black exterior to a light tan interior, concentrated in the upper-right quadrant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, irregularly shaped high-intensity white/cyan pixel clusters along the dorsal ridge (left edge), contrasting with larger, lower-density light-tan clusters in the central-right region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent 'O' rings in the upper-right quadrant form a near-equilateral triangle. A secondary linear chain of smaller blobs follows the curvature of the dorsal ridge on the left.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized rectangular patch of high-reflectivity golden-brown texture is visible in the lower central region, distinct from the surrounding pelt pattern. Multiple small, reddish-brown micro-lesions or specks are visible directly above this patch.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced bi-chromatic light distribution across the pelt, where highlights on the left edge show a cold cyan/blue spectral shift while highlights on the right show a warm golden/yellow spectral shift.
